full_page.content:
Page 57
Mar. 30th Oscar De Schutter - 33 - Arthritis - stiff back and neck, a plasterer by trade - has wife and five small children .....
Mrs. Ethel Bischoff - 40 - fearful asthma .... 17yrs ... 3 nerve-break 1943, April
April
Ist Mary Costello - 17 - very threatening leg. Drs. fear bad case of Ostimelitis - fear it must come off; mother here Tonight and Enrolls her as a perpetual member.
5th .Gert. Trozak - 3 - Kiefer Hosp. like lukemia - blood infection - En rolled Today 5.
Geo Smellie - 64 - Lutheran lung tumor ... bothering.8 months - Knelt and asked blessing with wife and enrolled in S. Masses ... 50c Promis- ing to study about ... Church if.
E'd Beyer - 24 - non cath. a sailor whose boat was torpedoed in Nov. was in water for 3 hours; come home Xmas day. His mother also non cath. had enrolled him in S.M. A. before he went away ... gone back to action again.
Page 58 April 5th Antoinette Belladello - 48 - lymphatic glands, etc. - has 3 children and husband to care for.
John Jos. Gray - 27 - has wife and three beautiful children, until recently has been good provider etc. ....
Jed Mancuso - 5 - Cleveland, Ohio - Ostemalitis ... phoned at 8:30 P.M. asking for prayers, wants to give Drs. a good surpriz
Mrs. Grace Fournier - 58 - serious Eye trouble - Drs baffled of Fern Mrs . Emma Nims - 59 - Erie Pa. - Cancer
Thanks - Mary Carmello - 82 - Bewick - 50 years in agony off and on stomach and head-aches !!! Enrolled a week ago ... O.K ....
Page 59 Apr. 8 Mrs. Em. Hall - 17 - inward cancer - serious almost a year; seems rather hopeless for doctors.
